description:
Connect Seline to ChatGPT to explore your website analytics in natural language.

Ask questions about traffic, visitors, pages, events, funnels, referrers, conversions, and trends without digging through dashboards or writing queries. Seline gives ChatGPT access to your analytics data so you can quickly understand what’s happening on your site, investigate changes, compare periods, and uncover useful insights from your visitors’ behavior.

Use it to answer questions like “What caused traffic to increase this week?”, “Which pages bring in the most engaged visitors?”, or “How is this month performing compared with last month?”

defaultPrompt: How many visitors from ChatGPT we've had in the past 30 days?
